command: python -m flight_simulator mission --brain connectome --backend flightgear --log runs/fg-mission6.csv --plot runs/fg-mission6.png

control.label: FLY BRAIN (connectome) flying the full mission (takeoff, circuit, landing)
control.neurons_decide: pitch (jump/rotation, flare), steering and roll through descending-neuron rates (DNp01/02/04/11, DNp07, DNp15, DNa02, DNp20, MN9)
control.code_decides: synthetic runway/path and known-obstacle sensory encoding of aircraft state, the fixed decoder from DN rates to controls, the behavioural-state gate (standing/flying), a fixed-gain pitch-rate reflex (haltere stand-in), speed-dependent ground steering limits/yaw damping, stale-decision rejection, a fixed flare pitch envelope, and phase handover (flies.py)
control.autopilot: never: the fly does not use the airplane autopilot/autothrottle; AutopilotGuard forces it off and stops the run if it cannot

fg_sessions.name: fly pilot holds the yoke: arms follow aileron/elevator (visual check + connectome takeoff)
